title: Constructing Barut-Girardello coherent states for the isotonic oscillator in the DOOT approach
summary: In this work, we study the quantum system of the isotonic oscillator from the perspective of the diagonal operator ordering technique (DOOT). Within this framework, we construct the associated Barut-Girardello and Gazeau-Klauder coherent states. We examine their mathematical properties using reproducing kernels and compute the expectation values of observables that characterize the system and its relevant physical features.
